question: Which of the following is an autobiography of the international tennis player Andre Agassi?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Open: An Autobiography__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Open: An Autobiography" **by **Andre Agassi**.
 
• Memoir of an iconic figure in **international tennis**.
 
• Offers an unfiltered look into **Agassi's life on and off the court**.
 
• Reveals the **highs and lows of his career**.
 
• Explores his struggles with **fame and personal identity**.
 
• Discusses his love for the game despite famously hating it at times.
 
• Provides candid insights into his journey from a child prodigy to a **world-renowned tennis player**.
 
• Showcases the complexities and contradictions of the human spirit in the competitive world of sports.
 
• **Agassi's depth** and **candour** make **"Open"** a compelling read.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Becoming**

 
 
• **"Becoming"** authored by **Michelle Obama**.
 
• Memoir published in **2018**.
 
• **Chronicles Obama's life** from childhood to her years in the **White House**.
 
 
 
• **Too Many Reasons to Live**
 
 
• **"Too Many Reasons to Live" **by **Benjamin Zander**.
 
• Published in **2002**.
 
• Explores **Zander's philosophy** on l**eadership, creativity, and life**.
